Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

story — a description of events. Example: It is a famous story.
tell — to say a story to someone. Example: She tells a good story.
beginning — the first part. Example: The story has a beginning.
middle — the central part. Example: The middle is the best part.
end — the last part. Example: The story has a happy end.
first — before all the others. Example: First, she finds a key.
then — after that. Example: Then she opens a door.
after that — later in a story. Example: After that she meets a character.
finally — at the end. Example: Finally, she goes home.
character — a person in a story. Example: She meets a strange character.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• First, ...
• Then ...
• After that ...
• Finally ...
